text_block_list.text:
"That day, sparked by a petty argument,
El Condor Pasa and Seeking the Pearl ended up
having a pro wrestling showdown...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just for fun,
as long as it carries the name of pro wrestling...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El will go all out, Pearl-senpai, desu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Bring it on!
Let's see if your skills hold up against the "World"!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, yes!
After all, El will spread her wings to the "world" someday!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, that really looks dangerous,
so I think you shouldn't...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! One must never refuse a challenge! For that is the destiny of those who carry the blood of a warrior!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Alright, Pearl-senpai! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Doryaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
A wild tackle like that won't work on me!

Seeking the Pearl swiftly dodges El Condor Pasa's
movements with a grand leap! The spectators cheer
at every single move, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Not yet, not yet!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... You're not gonna hit me!
Seeking the Pearl makes a big dodge away from El Condor Pasa's tackle, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: (Hah...! They're swerving way outside... In that case, if I make a sharp leap from the inside...!)
El Condor Pasa dashed as if she were flying!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see it!!
El Specialーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What?!
With sharp movements, El Condor Pasa slipped behind Seeking the Pearl in an instant and went for a joint lock!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I tap, I tap, I tap!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! It's El's wiiiiin!!
I pulled off the El Special for the first time!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What on earth are you all doing?!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gegeh, Air Groove-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
El. Come to the student council room later. We need to talk.
Pearl-senpai, please come along as well.

Though El Condor Pasa was scolded harshly,
the experience allowed her to master
supremely sharp and agile movements.
